evidence.note: Platform guidance requires key messages inside the UI safe zone. Exact organic UI geometry varies, so ONai uses a conservative internal proof rectangle.

topNavProfile.label: Reels title, back/camera controls and profile/header experiments

rightActionRail.label: Heart, comment, send/share, remix and overflow controls

bottomCaptionNav.label: Profile row, Reel caption, audio attribution and app navigation

faceAwarePlacement.rule: Track the face/head through the shot. Prefer the expertPortrait band below the head; use expertSplitFallback above the face only when the lower slot would collide with platform UI or leave insufficient clearance.

acceptance: Critical text, logos, CTA and active diagram nodes remain inside x=120..840 and y=260..1360.
Use only the matching compact 720x112 caption preset: podcast centerY=960, expert portrait centerY=1248, expert split fallback centerY=872, full graphics centerY=536.
For face shots, verify the active card clears the detected face/head by at least 32 px (48 px preferred).
No critical content intersects top navigation/profile, the right action rail or bottom caption/navigation zones.
Overlay is hidden before delivery export.
